svg.aria-label: Mandibular nerve (CN V3): branches in the infratemporal fossa — 下颌神经（CN V3）：颞下窝内的分支

text.aria-label: Mandibular nerve (CN V3): branches in the infratemporal fossa — 下颌神经（CN V3）：颞下窝内的分支
text.tspan: Mandibular nerve (CN V3): branches in the infratemporal fossa
下颌神经（CN V3）：颞下窝内的分支

text.aria-label: Meningeal branch (back through the foramen spinosum) — 脑膜支（经棘孔返回颅内）
text.tspan: Meningeal branch (back through the foramen spinosum)
脑膜支（经棘孔返回颅内）

text.aria-label: Mandibular nerve trunk — 下颌神经主干
Foramen ovale — 卵圆孔
Auriculotemporal nerve (behind the joint, then up) — 耳颞神经（经关节后方，再沿耳前上行）
text.tspan: Auriculotemporal nerve (behind the joint, then up)
耳颞神经（经关节后方，再沿耳前上行）

text.aria-label: Chorda tympani (CN VII) joins the lingual nerve — 鼓索（CN VII）加入舌神经
text.tspan: Chorda tympani (CN VII) joins the lingual nerve

text.aria-label: Nerve to lateral pterygoid — 翼外肌神经
Posterior division — 后干
Inferior alveolar nerve, entering the mandibular foramen — 下牙槽神经，进入下颌孔
text.tspan: Inferior alveolar nerve, entering the mandibular foramen
下牙槽神经，进入下颌孔

text.aria-label: Lingual nerve (anterior two-thirds of the tongue) — 舌神经（舌前三分之二）
text.tspan: Lingual nerve (anterior two-thirds of the tongue)

text.aria-label: Nerve to mylohyoid (mylohyoid, anterior belly of digastric) — 下颌舌骨肌神经（下颌舌骨肌、二腹肌前腹）
text.tspan: Nerve to mylohyoid (mylohyoid, anterior belly of digastric)
下颌舌骨肌神经（下颌舌骨肌、二腹肌前腹）

text.aria-label: Deep temporal nerves (to temporalis) — 颞深神经（至颞肌）
Anterior division — 前干
Nerve to medial pterygoid (from the trunk) — 翼内肌神经（发自主干）
text.tspan: Nerve to medial pterygoid (from the trunk)

text.aria-label: Masseteric nerve (through the mandibular notch) — 咬肌神经（穿下颌切迹）
Buccal nerve (sensory, to the cheek) — 颊神经（感觉，至面颊）
Inferior dental branches (lower teeth) — 下牙支（下牙）
Mental nerve, leaving the mental foramen — 颏神经，出颏孔
text.tspan: Mental nerve, leaving the mental foramen

text.aria-label: Drawn by hand because the 3D model has no mesh for them: meningeal branch, auriculotemporal, masseteric and deep temporal nerves, nerves to the pterygoids. — 以下分支 3D 模型里没有，为手工绘制：脑膜支、耳颞神经、咬肌神经、颞深神经和两条翼肌神经。
text.tspan: Drawn by hand because the 3D model has no mesh for them: meningeal branch, auriculotemporal, masseteric and deep temporal nerves, nerves to the pterygoids.
以下分支 3D 模型里没有，为手工绘制：脑膜支、耳颞神经、咬肌神经、颞深神经和两条翼肌神经。

text.aria-label: The outline of the lateral pterygoid is shown faintly; the nerve lies deep to it. Purple dashed line: chorda tympani. — 翼外肌轮廓以浅色显示，下颌神经位于其深面。紫色虚线：鼓索。
text.tspan: The outline of the lateral pterygoid is shown faintly; the nerve lies deep to it. Purple dashed line: chorda tympani.
翼外肌轮廓以浅色显示，下颌神经位于其深面。紫色虚线：鼓索。
Schematic; pathway and layers are simplified.
解剖示意；走行与层次经过简化。
